payload.description: Real-machine plan (docs/real-machine-curriculum.md section 6). Each wave ships alone and ends with lessons on the path. Contents: InstructionPanel (lenses, fields, lamps); Memory panel in lesson density; reg:pc; retires; c1/12-16 (drafts 06-08 re-cut). Riskiest assumption: hex and 4-byte shelves do not create a new cliff like the old lesson 06. Guardian playtest question: Can she say, with no total shown, which card a lamp pattern is, and where the second card of f starts?
